name: UI-Bench
description: UI-Bench is the first large-scale benchmark evaluating visual excellence of AI text-to-app tools through expert pairwise comparison. It covers 10 tools, 30 prompts, 300 generated sites, and over 4,000 expert judgments, establishing a reproducible standard for AI-driven web design evaluation.
reputation: A recent benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating AI text-to-app tools with expert visual judgments, but it is not yet widely established as a standard.
notes: Includes open-source evaluation framework and public leaderboard; focuses on AI text-to-app tool design quality.
